Natali Maharat, daughter of Gevte and Teshome, was born on 11 Nisan 5766 (9 April 2006) in Netanya. She was the sister of Asmo, Daniel, Ilana and Hadar.

On 17 March 2025 she enlisted in the IDF and served in the Border Defense Array Corps.

Sergeant Natali Maharat fell while carrying out her duties during the war on 14 Menachem Av 5786 (28 July 2026). She was twenty years old at the time of her death. She was laid to rest in the military cemetery in Netanya. She is survived by her parents and siblings.
